title: Clinical Study Report - NETTER-1 (Study 177Lu-DOTA0-Tyr3-Octreotate vs. High-Dose Octreotide)
summary: Primary CSR for the pivotal NETTER-1 trial supporting the NDA for LUTATHERA; includes TLF appendix and SDTM/ADaM dataset manifest.

title: Tables, Listings and Figures (TLF) Package - NETTER-1
summary: Full TLF output generated from the locked NETTER-1 analysis datasets, referenced by the CSR.

title: Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS)
summary: Pooled safety analysis across all LUTATHERA clinical studies, including AE/SAE narratives and MedDRA-coded adverse event datasets.

title: Integrated Summary of Efficacy (ISE)
summary: Pooled efficacy analysis across LUTATHERA clinical studies supporting the primary endpoint claims.

title: fdaclinpharmreqbaselab - Clinical Pharmacology Baseline Lab Dataset
summary: Baseline laboratory values (incl. CrCl) and dosing fields for the clinical pharmacology population across NETTER-1, Erasmus, and Netter-1-UK cohorts.

title: pktp - Pharmacokinetic Time-Point Dataset
summary: Per-patient PK sampling time points, dose, and derived exposure values (Cmax, AUC) for the PK sub-study.

title: supppc / supppp - Supplemental Qualifier Datasets
summary: Supplemental qualifier variables (IDVAR/IDVARAL) linked to the PC and PP domains for the clinical pharmacology datasets.

title: Define.xml - Clinical Pharmacology Datasets
summary: Metadata definitions (variable names, derivations, controlled terminology) for all clinical pharmacology SDTM/ADaM datasets.

title: Module 2.7.3 Summary of Clinical Efficacy
summary: High-level efficacy summary cross-referencing the ISE and individual study CSRs.
